questions.question: What is a webhook?
options: A tool for repeatedly polling an API on a timer
A callback where another system calls your endpoint the moment something happens, instead of you asking repeatedly
questions.explanation: A webhook flips the usual polling model: instead of you repeatedly asking 'anything new?', the other system calls you the instant there's something to report.

questions.question: Which Salesforce feature uses OData as one of its adapter types?
questions.explanation: Salesforce Connect can use an OData adapter to expose external, OData-compatible data as if it were a native Salesforce object.

questions.question: What does GraphQL let a client do that a typical fixed REST endpoint doesn't?
options: Specify exactly which fields it wants back, in a single request
Avoid using HTTP as a transport
questions.explanation: GraphQL lets the client shape its own query, requesting exactly the fields it needs instead of getting back a fixed response shape.

questions.question: What transport does the Pub/Sub API use to stream Platform Events and Change Data Capture?
questions.explanation: Pub/Sub API is built on gRPC, a high-performance binary RPC framework over HTTP/2.

questions.question: What's a key benefit of file-based integration (e.g. a nightly SFTP drop) over a live API call?
options: Neither side needs to expose a live API at the exact moment of transfer
It's always faster than any API call
questions.explanation: File-based integration decouples timing — the sender drops the file on its own schedule, and the receiver processes it independently, without either side needing to be live at the same instant.
